description: Policy for assigning a question type per CSF subcategory. compute_scope.py works out a STATE for each subcategory (a fact), then looks it up here. Change policy by editing this table, not the code.

frames.gap: {cert} covers control(s) {controls}, which partially addresses this area. Beyond that coverage: {text}
frames.confirmatory: {cert} should cover control(s) {controls}. Please confirm and provide named evidence: {text}
frames.fallback_question: How does your organisation address: {outcome}? Who owns this?

no_soa.reason: {cert}: no SoA provided, OLIR mapped — assuming coverage

not_in_soa.reason: {cert}: mapped controls not in SoA (mandatory clauses only) — assuming coverage

applicable_not_implemented.reason: {control} applicable but not implemented per SoA

implementation_unknown.reason: {control} applicable but implementation status not stated in SoA — confirm with evidence

covered_elsewhere.reason: {control} excluded in SoA as covered elsewhere

not_relevant.reason: {control} excluded in SoA as not relevant — assessor to check whether the outcome still applies

unclear.reason: {control} excluded in SoA, reason unclear — assessor to check whether the outcome still applies
